flavor: Sunmeadow rolls like a green ocean. Wind bends the tall grass around hidden paths. Morning dew glistens on moss and wildflowers.
Old Ruins stand half-buried in moss. Echoes make every step feel like a story returning. Something ghostly watches from the shadows.
Silver River glitters under shifting light. Smooth stones mark safe crossings for careful Keepers. Crystal wings flash at twilight.
Storm Canyon rumbles with distant thunder. Loose gravel punishes rushed movement. Only the tough and spined survive here.
Moonwood is cool and shadowed. Quiet observation reveals life before noise ever will. Moonlight filters through ancient boughs.
Thunder Highlands rise above the clouds. The air is thin and charged with static. Strange shapes drift on the wind currents.
